choices.content: \(AB\) is shorter than the radius of \(\odot O\).
It cannot be determined whether \(AB\) is a diameter.

question.prompt: In \(\odot O\), the inscribed angle subtended by chord \(AB\) is \(\angle ACB=90^\circ\). Which conclusion is correct?

solutions.explanation: The chord subtending a \(90^\circ\) inscribed angle is a diameter. This is the converse of the theorem about the inscribed angle subtended by a diameter.
solutions.title: Converse of the diameter-angle theorem
